oscar.name: Oscar Valdes
oscar.about: My background spans enterprise application support, AWS architecture, and engineering leadership. At Kalypso, I progressed from application support to leading Managed Services, supporting enterprise clients and building cloud hosting and deployment capabilities. My independent work now focuses on Kubernetes operations and practical Python automation.

experience.description: Hands-on work with EKS, Helm, application troubleshooting, network policies, autoscaling, and rollback testing. Additional projects explore AWS serverless applications and local LLM tooling.

experience.role: Senior Cloud Consultant · Lead Engineer, Managed Services
experience.description: Led a 7–12-person team supporting 10+ enterprise clients. Designed AWS architectures for PLM and IoT applications, provisioned infrastructure with Terraform, and built deployment pipelines and monitoring practices.
Initiated AWS hosting and DevOps offerings, designed client cloud architectures, and guided engineers on Windchill and ThingWorx deployments and support.

experience.role: Application Support Technician → Senior Application Support Technician
experience.description: Supported enterprise applications under SLA commitments, investigated clustering, database, and identity-integration issues, and developed troubleshooting practices.

experience.role: IT Analyst & Developer / Software Engineer Intern
experience.description: Developed and supported enterprise applications using .NET, JavaScript, and SQL Server.

oscar.education: Bachelor of Software Engineering · Universidad Regiomontana · 2015
